stories.summary: Train managers and motormen from Western Railway participated in the WNC Navy Half Marathon 2026 in Mumbai on Sunday, November 22, completing the 5 km and 10 km running categories. stories.summary: With nearly six lakh people entering Andheri East daily, Andheri East is facing pressure on its road infrastructure, prompting a renewed push to open long-pending Development Plan (DP) roads and improve connectivity.
